dedupe_keys.name: world bank global gas flaring tracker and flaring data gfmr

description: The World Bank's Global Flaring and Methane Reduction Partnership (GFMR), whose web address still carries the name of the earlier gas flaring reduction programme, publishes the Global Gas Flaring Tracker, described on the page read on 2026-09-26 as the only global and independent indicator of gas flaring. The latest tracker is dated June 2026, and interactive visualisations show individual flare sites with volumes in million cubic metres per year, flaring volume against oil production, flaring indicators by economy, and an Imported Flare Gas Index of crude importers' exposure to flaring. Estimates come from VIIRS satellite detections of flare heat, quantified by the Colorado School of Mines with NOAA and calibrated with country data from Cedigaz; about 10,000 flares are detected each year, and 167 billion cubic metres of associated gas were flared in 2025. Coverage is upstream oil and gas facilities and LNG plants worldwide. Access to the tracker and visualisations is free; no licence is stated and formats are web visualisations and reports. Caveats: volumes are satellite-based estimates calibrated to reported data, and site-level downloads were not seen on the page. Simulation uses are environmental exposure and emissions mapping of oil and gas sites and tracking of flaring reduction for climate policy. Related records: data-viirs-nightfire-gas-flaring-eog is the underlying satellite flare product, and data-gfei-global-fuel-exploitation-inventory grids methane emissions.
